text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: The heck? Everyone looks so serious…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Argh, dang it. I'm startin' to get antsy… Take deep breaths… Keep on keepin' it cool!

text_block_list.name: Miho Student A
text_block_list.text: Hishiamaaa! Show them what you're made of!

text_block_list.name: Miho Student B
text_block_list.text: You've got this, Hishiama! We're cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Aw, you guys! You made the time to come see me race?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Can't go losin' when I've got so many adoring eyes watching over me and cheering me on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon suddenly raises her hands…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With a clap to the cheeks, she gets her game face on!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Let's do this! Give me your best shot, 'cause I'm ready to take you all on!
